result.title: There's never been a better time to go into math
result.description:
Sharing a few thoughts on the future of math
These videos are funded directly by viewers: https://3b1b.co/support
An equally valuable form of support is to simply share the videos.
Home page: https://www.3blue1brown.com

If you want a finger on the pulse of how mathematicians are feeling right now, take a look at this post on Proofs and Prompt: 
https://proofsandprompts.com/2026/10/08/100-reactions-to-100-solutions/
